statement: The virtual-time cost model is proven viable as the bridge from logical-DST to the rolling-restart convergence verdict: a seed-deterministic in-process harness that hosts the HEAD-re-profiled CPU-sink path AND a coordination/leadership path on a per-node single-core charging clock reproduces docker's per-run ROOT-CAUSE LABELS for at least two mechanistically DISTINCT latency roots (one CPU-saturation missed-budget and one non-CPU coordination tail), each red-on-revert (removing the cost charge flips the label to converged), with the in-process directional verdict matching a docker single-run trace on the shared seed/inputs across a >=2-point parameter sweep. If this cannot be achieved with an honest cost model, the quest is EXHAUSTED and Option B is refuted at the kill-gate.

The evidence bar is per-run ROOT-CAUSE LABEL agreement with docker, never aggregate-passRate correlation (unfalsifiable at p~0.30/N~20). Docker keeps the passRate number and the T re-seal; this quest does not claim to reproduce them.
